question: Should QQBot keep `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` as a supported data-directory override, or should the diagnostic stop recommending it now that QQBot runtime state moved toward SQLite and `OPENCLAW_HOME`-aware media paths?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but deciding whether to add or retire this env surface affects plugin storage, path validation, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Support a validated override
options.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safely bounded `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require real diagnostic proof before merging the linked PR.

options.title: Retire the env hint
options.body: Remove or replace the `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` diagnostic guidance and close the linked implementation PR as not planned for this storage path.

recommendation.title: Support a validated override
recommendation.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safely bounded `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require real diagnostic proof before merging the linked PR.
